svg.text: Vattavada Business Manager: architecture overview (normalized sync, Oct 2026)
Offline-first PWA on every device -> Next.js API on Vercel (Hobby) -> Supabase Postgres (Free, 500 MB)
DEVICE (PWA: POS tablet, office PC, phones)
React pages (Next.js app router, client components)
POS · Orders · Invoices · Payments · Bookings · Rooms
Expenses · Ledger · Closing · Dashboard · Reports · Settings
renders from local data at once (never waits for the cloud)
sync loop: on open · online · every 15 s · 'Sync now' · SW message
header badge: Syncing… / N pending / N failed
in-memory AppState · domain rules · integer paise · Asia/Kolkata dates
every mutation -> outbox item (mutation_id = queue id)
push: batches ≤100 / 512 KB · pull: cursor, else legacy
first launch: copy legacy snapshot -> entity stores, validate, resume
EntityWriter: writes only changed rows · restores array order
kill switch 'Use legacy storage' · recovery points every 15 min
customers · products · rooms · tables · bookings · orders · orderItems
invoices · invoiceItems · payments · expenses · ledger · dailyClosings
shifts · auditLogs · conflicts (indexed: business+date, parent id…)
snapshots.primary: never cleared by the migration; persist.ts mirrors
state into it every 5 min for 30 days (rollback to the old client)
admin token (x-admin-token) · flags · backfill · reconcile · parity
monthly archive: download -> verify re-upload -> archive
VERCEL (Next.js 16 route handlers, service role key)
POST {items[≤100]} one transaction per batch · 413 if too big
status · reconcile · backfill (7 s budget, resumable)
payment-mix · reconciliation · stay (one RPC per screen)
used by the Dashboard when sql_reports is on
SYNC_FORCE_LEGACY=true -> behave like the old app
if the sync RPCs are missing (migrations not applied yet)
Add device authentication before relying on the cloud copy.
Normalized tables (text ids, paise, business dates)
bookings · orders · order_items · invoices · invoice_items · payments
+ change_seq (trigger: advisory lock + one global sequence)
+ FKs ON DELETE RESTRICT · partial/composite indexes
supabase db push · tests: npm run test:sql
